label: metre per second
definition: An SI derived unit of speed equal to a distance of one metre travelled in one second.
comment: The metre per second is the standard unit for wind speed and flow velocity in the corpus.

label: kilometre per hour
definition: A unit of speed equal to a distance of one kilometre travelled in one hour.
comment: One kilometre per hour equals 1/3.6 metre per second. It appears in some meteorological reports of wind speed.

label: mile per hour
definition: An imperial unit of speed equal to a distance of one statute mile travelled in one hour.
comment: One mile per hour equals 0.44704 metre per second. It is used for wind speed in studies that follow US or UK conventions.

label: cubic metre per second
definition: An SI derived unit of volumetric flow rate equal to one cubic metre passing a section in one second.
comment: The cubic metre per second is the standard unit for river discharge and design flow in hydropower studies.

label: cubic metre
definition: An SI derived unit of volume equal to the volume of a cube one metre on each side.
comment: The cubic metre is used for reservoir volumes and for volumes of water over a period.

label: million cubic metres
definition: A unit of volume equal to one million cubic metres.
comment: One million cubic metres equals one cubic hectometre (hm³) and is often abbreviated MCM. It is used for reservoir storage and annual runoff volumes.

label: metre
definition: The SI base unit of length.
comment: The metre is used for measurement heights, hydraulic heads, depths and wave heights.

label: millimetre
definition: A unit of length equal to one thousandth of a metre.
comment: The millimetre is used for precipitation depth, where 1 mm corresponds to one litre of water per square metre.

label: millimetre per year
definition: A unit of rate equal to a depth of one millimetre accumulated over one year.
comment: It is used for annual precipitation, runoff and evaporation.

label: inch per year
definition: An imperial unit of rate equal to a depth of one inch accumulated over one year.
comment: One inch equals 25.4 mm. It is used for annual precipitation in studies that follow US conventions.

label: kilometre per square kilometre
definition: A unit of length per unit area equal to one kilometre per square kilometre.
comment: It is used for drainage density, the total length of streams per unit area of a catchment.

label: watt per square metre
definition: An SI derived unit of power per unit area equal to one watt per square metre.
comment: The watt per square metre is used for wind power density and for solar irradiance.

label: kilowatt-hour per square metre
definition: A unit of energy per unit area equal to one kilowatt-hour per square metre.
comment: It is used for solar irradiation accumulated over a period, such as a month or a year.

label: megajoule per square metre
definition: A unit of energy per unit area equal to one megajoule per square metre.
comment: It is used for solar irradiation accumulated over a period; 3.6 MJ/m² equal 1 kWh/m².

label: watt-hour per square metre per day
definition: A unit of energy per unit area per day equal to one watt-hour per square metre in one day.
comment: It is used for daily solar irradiation; 1000 Wh/m²/day equal 1 kWh/m²/day.

label: kilowatt-hour per square metre per day
definition: A unit of energy per unit area per day equal to one kilowatt-hour per square metre in one day.
comment: It is the usual unit for daily solar irradiation. A value of 1 kWh/m²/day also equals one peak sun hour per day.

label: megajoule per square metre per day
definition: A unit of energy per unit area per day equal to one megajoule per square metre in one day.
comment: It is used for daily solar irradiation; 3.6 MJ/m²/day equal 1 kWh/m²/day.

label: kilowatt-hour per square metre per year
definition: A unit of energy per unit area per year equal to one kilowatt-hour per square metre in one year.
comment: It is used for annual solar irradiation and for annual energy yield per unit area.

label: megawatt-hour per square metre per year
definition: A unit of energy per unit area per year equal to one megawatt-hour per square metre in one year.
comment: It is used for annual solar energy potential per unit area.

label: terawatt-hour per year
definition: A unit of energy per year equal to one terawatt-hour produced or available in one year.
comment: One terawatt-hour equals 10¹² watt-hours. It is used for national or regional energy potentials.

label: gigawatt
definition: A unit of power equal to one billion watts.
comment: The gigawatt is used for national installed capacities and capacity targets.

label: gigawatt-hour
definition: A unit of energy equal to one gigawatt delivered for one hour.
comment: The gigawatt-hour is used for national or regional energy production and targets.

label: kilogram per year
definition: A unit of mass rate equal to one kilogram per year.
comment: It is used for annual emissions or avoided emissions.

label: tonne per year
definition: A unit of mass rate equal to one tonne (1000 kg) per year.
comment: It is used for annual emissions or avoided emissions.

label: tonne of CO2 equivalent
definition: A unit of greenhouse gas emissions equal to the warming effect of one tonne of carbon dioxide.
comment: Emissions of different greenhouse gases are converted into CO2 equivalent with their global warming potential so that they can be added and compared.

label: person
definition: A counting unit equal to one person.
comment: It is used for the number of people served or affected, such as inhabitants supplied with water.

label: household
definition: A counting unit equal to one household.
comment: It is used for the number of homes that could be supplied with electricity.

label: watt
definition: The SI derived unit of power, equal to one joule per second.
comment: The watt is used for the power of very small systems, such as single PV panels or micro wind turbines.

label: kilowatt
definition: A unit of power equal to one thousand watts.
comment: The kilowatt is used for the power of small turbines and small systems.

label: megawatt
definition: A unit of power equal to one million watts.
comment: The megawatt is used for the installed capacity and power potential of plants.

label: degree
definition: A unit of plane angle equal to 1/360 of a full rotation.
comment: The degree is used for wind direction, measured clockwise from north, and for slope and orientation angles.

label: radian
definition: The SI unit of plane angle, equal to the angle subtended at the centre of a circle by an arc as long as the radius.
comment: A full rotation measures 2π radians. The radian appears for angles such as wind direction in some statistical analyses.

label: degree Celsius
definition: A unit of temperature on the Celsius scale, equal in size to one kelvin.
comment: The degree Celsius is used for air and water temperature.

label: percent
definition: A dimensionless unit equal to one hundredth.
comment: The percent is used for probabilities, frequencies, efficiencies and capacity factors.

label: dimensionless
definition: The unit of a quantity that has no physical dimension, such as the ratio of two quantities of the same kind.
comment: It is used for shape parameters, coefficients and indices, such as the Weibull shape parameter k.

label: watt hour
definition: A unit of energy equal to one watt of power sustained for one hour.
comment: One watt hour equals 3600 joules.

label: kilowatt hour
definition: A unit of energy equal to one kilowatt of power sustained for one hour.
comment: The kilowatt hour is the usual unit of electricity consumption and billing.

label: megawatt hour
definition: A unit of energy equal to one megawatt of power sustained for one hour.
comment: It is used for the output of power plants over a period.

label: terawatt hour
definition: A unit of energy equal to one terawatt of power sustained for one hour.
comment: It is used for national or regional electricity production and potentials.

label: kilowatt hour per year
definition: A unit of annual energy equal to one kilowatt hour produced or consumed per year.
comment: It is used for the annual energy production of small systems.

label: megawatt hour per year
definition: A unit of annual energy equal to one megawatt hour produced or consumed per year.
comment: It is used for the annual energy production of turbines and plants.

label: gigawatt hour per year
definition: A unit of annual energy equal to one gigawatt hour produced or consumed per year.
comment: It is used for the annual energy production of large plants and regions.

label: kilowatt hour per square metre per month
definition: A unit of monthly irradiation equal to one kilowatt hour received per square metre in a month.
comment: It is used for monthly solar irradiation.

label: kilowatt per square metre
definition: A unit of power flux density equal to one kilowatt per square metre.
comment: It is used for solar irradiance and wind power density.

label: joule per square centimetre per day
definition: A unit of daily irradiation equal to one joule received per square centimetre in a day.
comment: One joule per square centimetre equals 0.01 megajoule per square metre.

label: square metre
definition: The SI derived unit of area.
comment: It is used for rotor swept areas, module areas and small land areas.

label: square kilometre
definition: A unit of area equal to one million square metres.
comment: It is used for catchment areas and land areas of plants.

label: hectare
definition: A unit of area equal to ten thousand square metres.
comment: It is used for land areas of solar plants and farms.

label: kilogram per cubic metre
definition: The SI derived unit of density.
comment: It is used for air density, about 1.225 kg/m³ at sea level in standard conditions.

label: kelvin
definition: The SI base unit of thermodynamic temperature.
comment: A temperature difference of one kelvin equals one degree Celsius.

label: pascal
definition: The SI derived unit of pressure, equal to one newton per square metre.
comment: It is used for atmospheric pressure, often in hectopascals.

label: revolution per minute
definition: A unit of rotational speed equal to one full turn per minute.
comment: It is used for the rotor speed of turbines and generators.

label: watt peak
definition: A unit of the nominal power of a photovoltaic module under standard test conditions.
comment: Standard test conditions are 1000 W/m² irradiance and 25 °C cell temperature.

label: kilowatt peak
definition: A unit of the nominal power of a photovoltaic system equal to one thousand watt peak.
comment: It is used for the size of photovoltaic installations.

label: second
definition: The SI base unit of time.
comment: It is used for computation times and short time steps.

label: minute
definition: A unit of time equal to sixty seconds.
comment: It is used for durations and time steps.

label: hour
definition: A unit of time equal to sixty minutes.
comment: It is used for durations, operating hours and sunshine duration.

label: day
definition: A unit of time equal to twenty-four hours.
comment: It is used for durations and periods.

label: year
definition: A calendar unit of time of about 365 days.
comment: It is used for lifetimes, payback periods and record lengths.

label: tonne
definition: A unit of mass equal to one thousand kilograms.
comment: It is used for masses of materials and of emissions.

label: tonne of carbon dioxide per year
definition: A unit of annual emissions equal to one tonne of carbon dioxide emitted or avoided per year.
comment: It is used for avoided or emitted greenhouse gases.

label: tonne of oil equivalent
definition: A unit of energy equal to the energy released by burning one tonne of crude oil.
comment: One tonne of oil equivalent is about 41.868 gigajoules; it is abbreviated TEP in French.

label: cubic metre per day
definition: A unit of volumetric flow equal to one cubic metre per day.
comment: It is used for water demand and pumped volumes.

label: cubic metre per month
definition: A unit of volumetric flow equal to one cubic metre per month.
comment: It is used for monthly water volumes.

label: millimetre per day
definition: A unit of rate equal to a depth of one millimetre accumulated over one day.
comment: It is used for daily precipitation and evaporation.

label: million cubic metres per year
definition: A unit of annual volume equal to one million cubic metres per year.
comment: It is used for annual runoff and water yield.

label: megawatt per square kilometre
definition: A unit of power density over land equal to one megawatt per square kilometre.
comment: It is used for the installed capacity density of wind and solar plants.

label: United States dollar
definition: The currency of the United States.
comment: Amounts are given in nominal dollars of the year stated by each study.

label: euro
definition: The currency of the euro area.
comment: Amounts are given in nominal euros of the year stated by each study.

label: South African rand
definition: The currency of South Africa.
comment: Amounts are given in nominal rand of the year stated by each study.

label: pound sterling
definition: The currency of the United Kingdom.
comment: Amounts are given in nominal pounds of the year stated by each study.

label: United States dollar per kilowatt hour
definition: A unit of the cost or price of energy in dollars per kilowatt hour.
comment: It is used for levelised costs and tariffs of electricity.

label: United States dollar per megawatt hour
definition: A unit of the cost or price of energy in dollars per megawatt hour.
comment: One dollar per megawatt hour equals 0.001 dollar per kilowatt hour.

label: United States dollar per kilowatt
definition: A unit of capital cost per unit of installed capacity.
comment: It is used for investment costs of power plants.

label: euro per kilowatt hour
definition: A unit of the cost or price of energy in euros per kilowatt hour.
comment: It is used for levelised costs and tariffs of electricity.

label: euro cent per kilowatt hour
definition: A unit of the cost or price of energy in euro cents per kilowatt hour.
comment: One euro cent per kilowatt hour equals 0.01 euro per kilowatt hour.

label: South African rand per kilowatt hour
definition: A unit of the cost or price of energy in rand per kilowatt hour.
comment: It is used for tariffs of electricity in South Africa.

label: Ghana cedi per kilowatt hour
definition: A unit of the cost or price of energy in Ghana cedis per kilowatt hour.
comment: It is used for tariffs of electricity in Ghana.

label: Central African CFA franc per kilowatt hour
definition: A unit of the cost or price of energy in CFA francs per kilowatt hour.
comment: It is used for tariffs of electricity in Central African countries such as Cameroon.

label: Central African CFA franc per cubic metre
definition: A unit of the cost or price of water in CFA francs per cubic metre.
comment: It is used for water tariffs in Central African countries.

label: Indian rupee per kilowatt hour
definition: A unit of the cost or price of energy in Indian rupees per kilowatt hour.
comment: It is used for tariffs of electricity in India.
